strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout with three promotions in src/cart.js `cartTotal`: 10% bulk discount at 10+ items (summing quantities), the SAVE5 coupon applied after the bulk discount with goods floored at $0 (other codes throw), and $4.99 shipping unless discounted goods reach $50 (empty cart is free). Unit tests in Vitest prove each rule and its boundaries through `cartTotal`. Reading the code, `bulkDiscount` uses `itemCount > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount, contrary to AC1 and to the constant's own doc comment ("at least this many"); that case is expected to fail and will be recorded as a defect.
inScope: cartTotal pricing: bulk discount, SAVE5 coupon, unknown coupons, shipping threshold, empty cart
outOfScope: Coupon case-sensitivity and stacking multiple coupons (not in the ticket)
UI/checkout flow beyond the pricing function (repo has only the pricing module)
assumptions: Prices are in dollars as plain numbers; totals are rounded to cents by cartTotal
A non-empty cart whose goods are $0 after the coupon still pays $4.99 shipping, since AC3 only waives shipping at $50+ or for an empty cart
Tests import the thresholds' behaviour through cartTotal and assert concrete dollar amounts computed from the ticket
openQuestions: Should a cart with lines of quantity 0 count as empty for shipping? The code treats only a cart with no lines as empty.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets no bulk discount.
The coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, the goods never cost less than $0, and any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when the goods cost $50 or more after discounts, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs nothing.

defects.title: Cart of exactly 10 items gets no bulk discount
defects.description: AC1: a cart with 10 or more items gets 10% off. src/cart.js bulkDiscount checks `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD` (BULK_THRESHOLD = 10), so a cart of exactly 10 items pays full price. The constant's own doc comment says "at least this many". Expected cartTotal([{price:10, quantity:10}]) = 90; actual 100.
defects.evidence: src/cart.js:22 `return itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD ? ...`; TC1 asserts 90 and is marked it.fails.
